project_type: TypeScript / Node 22 ESM MCP server (superset of Playwright MCP) with a local @receptron/laya on-device decision engine and an Autopilot goal loop
language: TypeScript (NodeNext, strict), some in-page JS injected via page.evaluate; Python 3.12 (uv) only for the offline ONNX export/quantize spike
build_system: pnpm; tsc for build/typecheck; vitest for tests. Scripts: pnpm run build, pnpm run typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm run bench (vitest test/benchmark/report.test.ts), pnpm run bench:compare (node benchmark/compare.mjs vs real @playwright/mcp over local fixtures)
test_framework: vitest (39 test files at main). Real headless Chromium fixtures used throughout; offline stub engine keeps suite green with NO weights. Real-weights path gated behind LAYA_MODEL_DIR.
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm run typecheck 2) pnpm run build 3) pnpm test (expect all pass, 3 skipped: WebKit self-skip + 2 LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated blocks) 4) pnpm run bench (offline vitest report, domwalk+aria) 5) optionally pnpm run bench:compare for the head-to-head vs @playwright/mcp (needs benchmark/node_modules; OPEN_INTERNET). Fast-path behavioral tests must FAIL if fast-path behavior regresses.
snapshot_or_generated_files: benchmark/RESULTS.md, benchmark/results.json, benchmark/charts/*.svg are produced by `pnpm run bench:compare`. They are committed artifacts (one recorded run). Regenerate with BENCH_RUNS=N pnpm run bench:compare. NEVER commit model weights (*.onnx / *.onnx.data / model/ are gitignored).
setup_instructions: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Chromium is preinstalled. WebKit cannot launch here (missing libs; its smoke test self-skips - expected). Python export/quantize spike uses uv with torch/transformers/onnx/onnxruntime available.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Node 22. WebKit unusable (self-skips). jev-ultrafast itself likely CANNOT run here (needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY + a text-model key + Browser Harness + real Chrome) - so the honest deliverable is laya's OWN before/after fast-path numbers on identical local fixtures, plus a qualitative jev comparison reasoned from measured per-step costs. Do NOT fabricate a jev head-to-head.
contribution_requirements: NO EM DASHES in any written content (README/docs/comments/scripts) - a prior review blocked on exactly this; use hyphens or parentheticals. Keep src/types.ts PURE (no playwright/onnx imports). Config parsed ONCE in src/config.ts (add flags there with env + bounds + defaults following the existing pattern). Make illegal states unrepresentable. Validate any structure returned from page.evaluate (untrusted boundary). Flag-gate the new fast loop default OFF for this PR so main's behavior is unchanged. Never commit weights; clean scratch/venv/downloads.
key_patterns: src/types.ts is the PURE core (Ref branded string, Control, PageState, Decision discriminated union, LayaDecisionEngine). src/snapshot.ts owns the ref/snapshot boundary: capture() injects a self-contained domWalk() via page.evaluate that STAMPS data-laya-ref=eN attributes and returns Snapshot{url,title,visibleText,controls,text}; refs are re-numbered per capture and only valid within one snapshot (NO cross-snapshot identity - snapshot-diff.ts reconstructs identity heuristically by role+name). src/browser.ts BrowserSession owns lifecycle + resolveRef('eN')/locate('eN') which RE-QUERY page.locator('[data-laya-ref=eN]') at act time. It has probeSettle(page,{beforeUrl}) quiet-period settle (DEFAULT_SETTLE_PROBE_MS=400, DEFAULT_SETTLE_QUIET_MS=120) but NO per-node semantic freshness guard and NO occlusion hit-test. src/autopilot/loop.ts runGoal: capture->buildState->policySeed(rule,0.97)->engine.decide->confidence check(0.85 gate on main? NO-main default is 0.85 via DEFAULT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD)->escalate->execute->settle. It ALREADY overlaps a speculative CAPTURE with the settle probe (T4.1 prefetchedSnapshot) but does NOT overlap a speculative DECIDE. src/autopilot/policy.ts: RULE_CONFIDENCE=0.97; Rule 1a already batches 2+ unfilled goal fields into ONE FILL_FORM. src/laya/engine.ts: decide() asks operation+target as two narrow choice questions in one systemOne pass; OPERATIONS is the trained compact set. src/laya/goal.ts: goal grammar (goalAssignments, fieldValueFromGoal, unfilledGoalFields, isSubmitControl, goalSuccessMarkers). src/state-builder.ts buildState caps controls to 20 (RECOMMENDED_MAX_OPTIONS) and clamps option lengths for head_max_len.

test/fixtures/ (local HTML fixtures), benchmark/tasks.mjs, benchmark/compare.mjs, benchmark/runner.mjs, benchmark/server.mjs (head-to-head harness)
docs/PLAN.md (authoritative design log + verified/inferred/guessed ledger - add a new phase section)
README.md (explain fast path, the flag, honest benchmark methodology + before/after numbers)
